dict.string: Agent Computer Use reads and drives app controls for the tasks you ask for.
Agent Computer Use controls apps you ask it to use (Music, Spotify, Finder, Comet, System Events, TextEdit). Each app is asked once.
The Dynamic Island shows your next event and a countdown. Read-only: it never changes your calendars.
The Dynamic Island shows your next event and a countdown. Read-only: it never changes your calendars.
The island can silence its one-line peeks while a Focus is on. It only reads whether a Focus is active.
Samantha listens for spoken tasks when you turn her on.
Agent Computer Use sees the target window when its controls are unreadable, so the agent can check its work.
